notes.title: SOUL SHIFTER RELEASE
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

Exciting news! Soul Shifter has officially launched out of early access!

Developing Soul Shifter marked a crucial milestone in Innominatum Digital's journey. As we continue to work on our upcoming title, Dash & Swing (available on Steam), and venture into the world of horror game development, we can't help but feel immense pride in what we've achieved with Soul Shifter. Now, it's with great joy that we release this game to you, our amazing players, and we sincerely hope you have a blast playing it.

Here's what the latest update brings to the table:

[list]
[*] [b]Revamped UI: [/b]We've listened to your feedback and made significant changes and improvements to the user interface, menus, and HUDs. Now, navigating the game is even more intuitive and visually appealing.
[*] [b]Enhanced Balancing and Difficulty: [/b]Your gaming experience is our priority, so we've fine-tuned the gameplay to strike the perfect balance between challenge and enjoyment. Get ready for an even more immersive adventure!
[*][b] Bug Squashing: [/b]We've been hard at work squashing pesky bugs to ensure a smoother and more seamless gaming experience. Your journey through Soul Shifter should now be free from those frustrating hiccups.
[/list]

Thank you all for being part of our community and supporting us throughout this incredible journey. We couldn't have done it without you! So, jump into Soul Shifter now and let the adventure unfold.

See you in the game!

[b]The Innominatum Digital Team[/b]
